newsitem.title: CANADA: Cableshare recommends Source Media bid.
newsitem.headline: Cableshare recommends Source Media bid.

text.p: Cableshare Inc said on Tuesday its board approved a C$18.3 million share exchange takeover offer from Source Media Inc.
Under the offer, Source Media will acquire all of Cableshare's class A subordinate voting shares and class B multiple voting shares.

Source Media would acquire the Cableshare shares in exchange for C$2.25 worth of Source Media common shares for each Cableshare share, subject to a re-negotiable condition that not fewer than five Cableshare shares are to be exchanged for each Source Media common share or exchangeable share.

Cableshare said the value of the share consideration will be determined by the weighted average trading price of Source Media on Nasdaq over 20 trading days prior to the third business day before the Cableshare annual meeting. Approval of the deal will be sought at the shareholder meeting.

Each exchangeable share is to be redeemable or exchangeable for one Source Media common share and to have dividend and liquidation entitlements equal to those of the Source Media common shares, Cableshare said.
